venues.name: Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Tickets are sold at the Razorback Ticket Center (located next to Baum Stadium), Monday - Friday from 8:30 am - 4:30 pm. On gameday, tickets are sold at Reynolds Razorback Stadium on the southwest corner at Gate 1 and opens 3 hours before kick-off.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, Check, or Cash
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tickets held at Will Call may be picked up at the Razorback Ticket Center, Monday - Friday from 8:30 am - 4:30 pm. A photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order must be presented at the time of pick up. Tickets held at Will Call to be picked up on gameday are located at Reynolds Razorback Stadium on the southwest corner at Gate 1 and opens 3 hours before kick-off.

venues.parkingDetail: Stadium Parking Parking lots to be used for home football games are indicated on the football parking maps on the University of Arkansas Transit and Parking website at parking.uark.edu. Also available is a listing of parking policies, maps and diagrams, pre- and post-game traffic flow and shuttle information for all Razorback home football games. Vehicles will be relocated from the designated parking lots by midnight prior to kick-off. Season parking passes are issued to Razorback Foundation members for football season ticket holders as part of their Razorback Foundation membership benefits. These passes are issued in designated lots according to donation level. Single-game parking is available free of charge at Baum Stadium. Spaces are filled on a first-come, first-served basis on game day. Shuttle service is provided to and from Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium beginning four hours prior to game time.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessibility (ADA) Seating All requests for season tickets in the accessible seating areas will be filled first (based on availability). If no seats remain after filling season orders, then no single-game accessible seating will be sold. Please call the Razorback Ticket Center at (479) 575-5151 with any specific accessibility need in advance of your event to enable us to serve you better.

generalInfo.generalRule: Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium Information Gates All gates to Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium open 2 hours before game time. Re-Entry There will be no re-entry passes issued. If you leave the stadium, you must present a full ticket to re-enter. Smoking Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium is a non-smoking facility.
generalInfo.childRule: Everyone must have a ticket regardless of age.
